_note: Feeds for scripts/sync-episodes.py. Give each show an 'rss' URL, an Apple Podcasts 'apple_id', or a 'spotify_show' id (the part after open.spotify.com/show/). RSS/Apple are used first; Spotify needs the SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID and SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET repository secrets. Shows with none are skipped. A 'spotify_episode' id is enough: the sync looks up its show.
